verdict.rationale: First-party docs and GitHub examples show natural-language goals (e.g., 'Find the top Hacker News story', 'Fill in this job application', 'Extract structured data... export as CSV') executed end-to-end via the client library, with community confirmation of real-world use like LinkedIn automation. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks quantifying success rates across complex multi-step flows, and more varied hands-on third-party demonstrations beyond a few examples.
